title: Learning to Read Events for Exact State Tracking with Frozen Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.25211v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long event streams require identifying each change and applying the changes in order. We train a selector on a frozen language model to read each transition. With API-only access, we ask the model to list the transitions. An external integer register composes them in order. A confidence rule can flag uncertain updates or retain several candidates. We study products of permutations of five items, a task that fixed-depth, log-precision transformers cannot solve on all input lengths under the standard conjecture that $\mathrm{TC}^0 \ne \mathrm{NC}^1$. On two-event windows, a 27B model answered 3 of 100 correctly without visible reasoning and 96 of 100 when it generated intermediate steps. A frozen 0.8B model with a trained selector read every event in 299 of 299 windows of 43,687 events each. The same package passed 298 of 299 new windows on a fresh machine, missing the target of 0.99 for the one-sided 95% lower confidence bound. A separa

translated_title: 使用冻结语言模型学习读取事件以实现精确状态跟踪
translated_abstract: 长事件流需要识别每一个变化并按顺序应用这些变化。我们在冻结的语言模型上训练一个选择器来读取每个状态转换。在仅有API访问权限的条件下，我们让模型列出这些转换，然后由外部整数寄存器按顺序将它们组合起来。置信度规则可以标记不确定的更新或保留多个候选。我们研究了五个元素置换的乘积这一任务，在TC⁰ ≠ NC¹的标准猜想下，固定深度、对数精度的transformer无法在所有输入长度上解决该任务。在两事件窗口上，一个27B模型在没有可见推理的情况下100个问题仅答对3个，而在生成中间步骤时100个问题答对96个。一个带有训练选择器的冻结0.8B模型，在299个窗口（每个窗口包含43,687个事件）中全部正确读取了每个事件。同一套系统在另一台新机器上的299个新窗口中通过了298个，未能达到单侧95%置信下界0.99的目标。
tldr: 该论文提出在冻结语言模型上训练一个轻量级选择器来读取事件流中的每个状态转换，并通过外部整数寄存器按序组合更新，从而实现精确状态跟踪，理论上能够解决固定深度transformer在TC⁰ ≠ NC¹猜想下无法解决的任务。
en_tdlr: The paper trains a lightweight selector on frozen language models to read each transition in event streams and composes updates in order via an external integer register, achieving exact state tracking and theoretically solving tasks that fixed-depth transformers cannot under the TC⁰ ≠ NC¹ conjecture.
